import unittest
from subject import fixture


class VaultWriteLockTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_primary_cache_trusted(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            self.assertFalse(s.fallback_ready())

    def test_normal_not_held_before_lock(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_normal_lock_held_inside(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())

    def test_normal_lock_released_after_exit(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            with s.lock():
                pass
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_normal_reentrant(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            with s.lock():
                with s.lock():
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_normal_reentrant_triple(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            with s.lock():
                with s.lock():
                    with s.lock():
                        self.assertTrue(s.held())
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_normal_relock_after_release(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            with s.lock():
                pass
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_cache_moved_primary_untrusted(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            self.assertTrue(s.fallback_ready())

    def test_cache_moved_still_locks(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())

    def test_cache_moved_no_external_write(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                self.assertFalse(s.external_written())
            self.assertFalse(s.external_written())

    def test_cache_moved_released_after_exit(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                pass
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_cache_moved_reentrant(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                with s.lock():
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                    self.assertFalse(s.external_written())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_cache_moved_reentrant_triple(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                with s.lock():
                    with s.lock():
                        self.assertTrue(s.held())
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.external_written())

    def test_cache_moved_relock_after_release(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                pass
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.external_written())
